title: Data-flow conformance case
description: One case of the shared data-flow conformance corpus (ADR 0012 Decision 10). See README.md.

name.description: <area>/<file name without .yaml>. Unique across the corpus; divergence lists refer to it.

test.description: The test name a runner reports the case under, givenX_whenY_thenZ. Unique across the corpus.

area.description: The coverage area, equal to the case's directory.

summary.description: What the case proves, in one sentence.

source.description: Where the expected result comes from: the OWS 1.0.0 spec, openspec workflow-data-flow, or an ADR 0012 decision.

engine.description: What the jq engine in use today does with the expression, when that matters (for example a builtin it does not implement).

uses.description: Every task kind the workflow contains, sorted. Lets a runtime select the cases it can run.

context.description: The workflow context when the top-level do list ends.

fault.description: The instance fails with a data-flow fault.

location.description: JSON Pointer of the offending instance location, for a schema failure.

detailContains.description: Strings the fault detail must contain, such as the unsupported form or the blocked builtin.
